description: This source file implements a backup scheduling and execution system, managing backup tasks via timers, threads, and state management. It includes functions to schedule, cancel, and force backups, and executes a backup script when triggered.

methods.name: isBackupRunning
methods.description: Checks if a backup job is currently in progress based on internal state.

methods.name: isBackupScheduled
methods.description: Checks if a backup job is scheduled for later based on internal state.

methods.name: cancelScheduledBackup
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled backup if it is currently scheduled.

methods.name: scheduleBackup
methods.description: Schedules a backup to occur after a specified delay, if no backup is currently scheduled or running.

methods.name: scheduleBackupIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts to schedule a backup at a random delay, in minutes or hours based on configuration, if no backup is active.

methods.name: forceBackup
methods.description: Performs an immediate backup, ignoring any scheduled timer.

methods.name: internalRunBackup
methods.description: Executes the backup script to perform the backup operation.
